# stalwart_sharing (Resource)

Configures sharing settings for calendars, address books, and files. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_directory_queries` (Boolean) Whether authenticated users can query the directory via WebDAV and JMAP
- `max_shares` (Number) Specifies the maximum number of sharees that can be added to a single shared item (calendar, address book or file)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
